Chapter 637: Chapter 47 ‘Aiding the Enemy’? (5200 words, please subscribe)_3

“`

“Tsk, tsk, the Galaxy Master has finally made an appearance.”

“Is that the Galaxy Master? The cosmic will really favors humans too much. When compared with us, special life forms bestowed with innate talents… those Galaxy Masters…”

“Being able to witness the Galaxy Master in action, this trip to the secret realm is indeed worthwhile.”

…

The multitude of ninth-order strong ones talked and laughed with one another, seemingly at ease.

...

At ease? Of course they were, since it wasn’t them who had to endure the beating.

“Hmm?”

“The Galaxy Master has made a move.”

“Who are those four strong ones that suddenly appeared?”

“Children of the Tree Realm? And the Dragon Scale King? Those peak clans really went all out, even inviting these individuals.”

The group of ninth-order strong ones who were watching the battle suddenly widened their eyes.

Originally, they thought it would be a one-sided situation. With the strength of the Galaxy Master, the ninth-ranked alien race’s side would surely face a complete defeat.

After all, that group of ninth-rank aliens from different species couldn’t possibly cooperate wholeheartedly. Facing the matchless Galaxy Master, they would definitely think to just run faster than the other strong ones.

Who would stay behind and desperately hold back the Galaxy Master?

However, the appearance of the Children of the Tree Realm and the Dragon Scale King, along with the other two special ninth-rank individuals, showed the many ninth-order strong ones another possibility.

If these four special ninth-rank individuals could hold back the Galaxy Master, the remaining human civilization evolvers would find it difficult facing the counterattack from thousands, if not tens of thousands, of ninth-rank aliens from different species.

“Galaxy Master, who would have thought that in this era, such an unrivalled genius like you would emerge?” The Child of the Tree Realm, maintaining its ancient tree form, sent out mental waves, filled with a fighting spirit as it looked at Lin Yuan.

The other three were the same.

The reason they agreed to support the ninth rank alien race within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was not only because those peak clans paid a hefty price.

It was also because they wanted to witness an opponent like the Galaxy Master.

“You’ve also come to court death?” Lin Yuan continued to manipulate the power of the numerous spatial layers. Now that he knew the purpose of the different species, he naturally would not reveal more of his strength.

Instead, he kept the number of spatial layers around the two hundred million mark.

The inability to increase the number of spatial layers didn’t mean Lin Yuan could not use other means.

For instance, the “Mysterious Yellow Strike”?

Mastering the first phase of “Mysterious Yellow Strike” allowed Lin Yuan’s every strike to explode with twice the force.

This force did not come from the strength of the spatial layers but was specially amplified, and merely double, not too exaggerated.

The real peculiarity of “Mysterious Yellow Strike” wasn’t the degree of enhancement, even at the strongest Perfection level, the increase was only fivefold.

But it was the ‘constant’ effect.

Every strike could maintain the corresponding multiplicative increase, which was the most precious aspect of “Mysterious Yellow Strike.”

However, to confirm this, one would have to battle Lin Yuan for years or even decades; otherwise, it would be imperceptible.

If it were just one or two strikes, at most, one could conclude that an explosive power-type secret technique had been used.

Boom, boom, boom.

Under the enhancement of “Mysterious Yellow Strike,” Lin Yuan’s attacks underwent a qualitative change. The Child of the Tree Realm and the other three special ninth-rank beings immediately had difficulty resisting and began to retreat explosively.

…

“When the Galaxy Master killed Hunyi, he wasn’t at full strength?”

“It’s too terrifying, even with the four of them working together, they are still forced to retreat by the Galaxy Master?”

“It’s over, we probably won’t be able to leave alive.”

Within the canyon, many ninth-rank aliens from different species suddenly came to a realization.

“Around two hundred million spatial layers, possessing a secret technique that doubles the strength? The leading Ninth Rank Insect Race observed closely.

And finally reached a conclusion.

“This should be the true strength of the Galaxy Master. As long as we can determine the Galaxy Master’s strength, no price would be too great.”

The Ninth Rank Insect Race thought to itself silently.

“`

Only by determining their specific strength could they devise targeted strategies for the future.

Otherwise, it would be a repeat of a scene from the Battlefield of Different Races, with the Tianyu Clan constantly deploying their Eighth Layer invincibles, one after another sending Ninth-tier Secret Treasures to the Galaxy Master.

…

In a distant canyon.

The numerous Ninth Rank strong ones were dumbstruck.

“The Galaxy Master… The Galaxy Master is too powerful,”

“How did he suppress the Child of the Tree Realm, the Dragon Scale King, so miserably?”

“It’s inconceivable.”

Each of the Ninth Rank powerhouses shivered in their minds as they watched the battle from an incredibly distant location, occasionally feeling the remnants of combat that made their scalps tingle.

One could imagine the overwhelming pressure borne by those who were at the periphery of the battlefield, let alone those few who faced the Galaxy Master.

…

Boom, boom, boom.

The forces of the numerous Spatial Layers, further empowered by the “Mysterious Yellow Strike,” transformed into terrifying blows, one after another, making the four strong ones including the Child of the Tree Realm suffer tremendously.

Boom.

It was at this moment that one of the strong ones exploded, falling on the spot.

Of course, what had fallen was merely an avatar that had entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm; whether the Child of the Tree Realm or the Dragon Scale King, what they had sent were just avatars.

“There’s no escape.”

The Child of the Tree Realm sighed internally. The four of them, united, were teetering on the brink of collapse before the Galaxy Master. Now that one had died, they had even less hope.

…

In the canyon below.

Seeing that there was no chance for the situation to turn around, the Ninth Rank Insect Race turned around and looked at the many Ninth Rank Alien Races behind them and said, “Gentlemen, the Galaxy Master is cruel. If we continue to stay here, we will eventually die at the hands of the Galaxy Master.”

After the Ninth Rank Insect Race finished, it looked at the faces of the many Ninth Rank Alien Races and continued to say:

“That being the case, it would be better for us to directly enter the inner and the core areas. These areas are much larger than the peripheral zone. It’s basically impossible for human Evolvers to set up a blockade in the inner core areas.”

As soon as these words were spoken,

the many Ninth Rank Alien Races on the scene immediately understood the meaning.

Rather than die at the hands of the Galaxy Master or human Evolvers,

it would be better to hide in the inner and the core areas. There the range far exceeded that of the peripheral zones, and it was impossible for human civilization’s Evolvers to establish another blockade.

Even if the Secret Realm was to eventually close, them dying from the Secret Realm’s annihilation was preferable to their treasures falling into the hands of human civilization’s Evolvers.

After all, they were going to die one way or another.

Why ‘aid the enemy’?

“Let’s go, let’s go, let’s go.”

“We’ll head to the inner area now.”

“Right, even in death, we can’t let human civilization gain any benefits.”

The numerous Ninth Rank Alien Races within the canyon immediately flew toward the inner and core areas.

…

Up in the sky.

Lin Yuan crushed the last Child of the Tree Realm to dust and then saw numerous Ninth Rank Alien Races fleeing towards the inner and core areas.

“Once the Xuanhuang Secret Realm closes, all outsiders in the inner and core areas… they would rather leave their collected treasures in the Secret Realm than let human Evolvers have them?”

Lin Yuan immediately figured out the intentions of those Ninth Rank Alien Races.

Then a strange look emerged on his face. What difference was there between leaving their collected treasures in the Secret Realm and giving them to him?
